The '''Advanced Iridium Rod''' is a [[Tools|tool]] used to catch [[fish]]. It can have [[bait]] and 2 [[tackle]]s attached to it. 

One is obtained after claiming [[Mastery Cave#Masteries|Fishing Mastery]]. Afterwards, additional rods can be purchased from the [[Fish Shop]] for {{Price|25000}}.

The Advanced Iridium Rod can be given a random [[Forge#Tool enchantments|enchantment]] at the Forge.

==Notes==
*The effects of the two tackles [[Tackle#Stacking|stack]] (except for two [[Sonar Bobber]]s or two [[Curiosity Lure]]s). For example, using two [[Cork Bobber]]s will increase the [[Fishing#Bar Size|fishing bar size]] by 48 pixels, compared to 24 with using only one.

==Secret==
{{collapse|content=
Putting [[Secrets#Lucky Purple Shorts|Lucky Purple Shorts]] in the tackle slot of a fishing rod changes the [[Fish Shop#Bobber Machine|bobber style]] to a unique Lucky Purple Shorts bobber. If placed in the first slot of an Advanced Iridium Rod, the shorts prevent the tackle in the second slot from losing durability. This cannot be done with Trimmed Lucky Purple Shorts.}}
